i.norm: Verifies that flushing an XmlStreamWriter backed by a null OutputStream is a no-op (no exception is thrown because flush() only delegates when an internal writer has been initialised, which it has not at this point), and that the default encoding reported by the writer is "UTF-8" as documented.
Arrange: writer is created with a null stream; no write has been performed yet, so no internal OutputStreamWriter has been initialised.
Act: flush before any write – the writer field is still null, so flush is a no-op.
Assert: the declared default encoding must be "UTF-8".
